fields.name: override_force_location_x
fields.description: If not -1, this coordinate overrides location of army on map in campaign select panel. It's calculated by dividing the x coordinate by the map's height in hexes (e.g. if the x position of the character is 326 and the map width is 1440 hexes the calculation is: 326 / 1440).  To deal with lords that are teleported immediately when starting campaign.

fields.name: override_force_location_y
fields.description: If not -1, this coordinate overrides location of army on map in campaign select panel. It's calculated by dividing the y coordinate by the map's width in hexes (e.g. if the y position of the character is 125 and the map height is 970 hexes the calculation is: 125 / 970).  To deal with lords that are teleported immediately when starting campaign.

fields.name: multiplayer_cost
fields.description: This is the value (in gold) that a unit or character is worth in custom battle and quick battle.

fields.name: recruitment_cost
fields.description: This field is for setting the recruitment gold value of a unit in campaign. This field is no longer relevant for characters, as it is overridden in the agent_subtypes table.

fields.name: in_encyclopedia
fields.description: Generally, this is the case. However some units (mainly bastions) are not in the encyclopaedia and the code will look up the redirects table

fields.name: ui_unit_group_land
fields.description: This field defines what unit category icon and title is used for a unit. A unit's category also defines which larger category it sits in the custom battle menu. e.g. Infantry, Cavalry etc.

fields.name: tier
fields.description:
Used in the UI to show the Tier of unit

This is the general rule for approximating a unit tiers:
=IF([@[multiplayer_cost]]=0, - do nothing
IF([@[multiplayer_cost]] is less than 500, - unit tier 1,
IF([@[multiplayer_cost]] is less than 1000, - unit tier 2,
IF([@[multiplayer_cost]] is less than 1500, - unit tier 3,
IF([@[multiplayer_cost]] is less than 2000, - unit tier 4,
else - unit tier 5

Characters don't have tiers.

fields.name: is_high_threat
fields.description: High threat units override the entity threshold checks of melee reactions. If they run into or attack a unit, the unit will instantly react, even if less than 25% of their entities are affected.

fields.name: porthole_composite_scene
fields.description: Full path of composite scene to use for porthole in battle (optional, if empty will just render unit from battle. Only required for special circumstances like chariots). Note that switching armies through DEV UI breaks 3D Portholes

fields.name: melee_cp
fields.description: Base Melee Combat Potential of this unit. Must be >= 0.0 or the game will crash on startup. This value is modified (increased) by other factors such as Rank and equipped Abilities / Items. Reduced by 20% for missile cav.

fields.name: missile_cp
fields.description: Base Missile Combat Potential of this unit. Must be >= 0.0 or the game will crash on startup. This value is modified (increased) by other factors such as Rank and equipped Abilities / Items. Reduced by 20% for missile cav.

fields.name: can_siege
fields.description: If true, can attack the turn a settlement is besieged - do not need to wait to build siege equipment on the campaign map

fields.name: is_monstrous
fields.description: For voiceover : Is this unit regarded as monstrous?

fields.name: multiplayer_qb_cap

fields.name: vo_is_dragon

fields.name: vo_is_dinosaur

fields.name: damage_mod_physical

fields.name: damage_mod_missile

fields.name: damage_mod_all

fields.name: can_brace

fields.name: sync_locomotion

fields.name: flying_charge_speed

fields.name: gradient_strategy

fields.name: combat_reaction_radius

fields.name: hit_reactions_ignore_chance

fields.name: knock_interrupts_ignore_chance

fields.name: vfx_filter_id
fields.description: Used to filter effect metadata that should only trigger for some entities and not others, e.g. heroes. The 'id' field of the metadata must match this id if not 0, to be triggered.

fields.name: can_cast_projectile
fields.description: does this entity cast a projectile spell

fields.name: porthole_composite_scene
fields.description: Full path of composite scene to use for porthole in battle (optional, if empty will just render unit from battle. Only required for special circumstances like chariots)

fields.name: has_blood
fields.description: Whether this entity can bleed (NOT if the model can receive blood on it - that is controlled in the model's material)

fields.name: can_dismember
fields.description: Whether this entity can be dismembered

fields.name: combat_camera_shake
fields.description: Camera shake parameters to use for combat animations. This to tied to metadata.

fields.name: dismember_head_alive_hp_ratio
fields.description: If +ve, this entity can have its head dismembered while still alive. Value is fraction of full hitpoints.

fields.name: dismember_arms_alive_hp_ratio
fields.description: If +ve, this entity can have its arms dismembered while still alive. Value is fraction of full hitpoints.

fields.name: jump_attack_chance
fields.description: Percentage chance of performing jump attack (0..100)

fields.name: locomotion_constants

fields.name: enable_engine_crew_turn_in_movement_direction
fields.description: Engine crew will turn to face their direction of movement rather than use the engine's orientation

fields.description: Multiplier for the collision speed delta threshold to apply to the victim of the collision

fields.name: dealt_collision_knocked_down_threshold_multiplier
fields.description: Multiplier for the collision speed delta threshold to apply to the victim of the collision

fields.name: dealt_collision_knocked_back_threshold_multiplier
fields.description: Multiplier for the collision speed delta threshold to apply to the victim of the collision

fields.name: anim_lod_distance_multiplier
fields.description: Multiplier for the distance at which animation quality is reduced.

fields.name: size_for_animation_lod

fields.name: leaves_collision_when_dies

fields.name: stop_before_turn
fields.description: Enable/disable stopping before turn.

fields.name: bonus_v_large
fields.description: Will trigger against anything that is not Inf, not only large!

fields.name: weapon_length
fields.description: Relevant for pikes, cav refusal distances and close proximity. The latter picks between this and 1m + entity radius, whatever is longer, to determine weapon "reach". Chariot riders use this to check if enemies are within reach.

fields.name: splash_attack_target_size
fields.description: Do splash attacks when fighting up to this size

fields.name: splash_attack_max_attacks
fields.description: Maximum entities to attack per splash attack animation. Note that High Priority targets (main units table) allways get treated focussed damage.

fields.name: splash_attack_power_multiplier
fields.description: Multiplier to knock power in splash attack metadata

fields.name: building_damage_multiplier
fields.description: Damage multiplier applied when hitting buildings

fields.name: ignition_amount
fields.description: How much do we contribute towards ignition. Also, use to determine as being flaming for context

fields.name: is_magical
fields.description: Is this weapon considered magical

fields.name: contact_phase
fields.description: Do we cause a phase effect to the targets unit on hit

fields.name: collision_attack_max_targets
fields.description: Maximum targets damaged by collision attack. This cap is refreshed by collision_attack_max_targets_cooldown.

fields.name: collision_attack_max_targets_cooldown
fields.description: Each second, this amount of targets will be removed from the max targets list, enabling the collision attacker to deal more attacks.

fields.name: melee_attack_interval
fields.description: Min interval between the start of each attack animation

fields.name: scaling_damage
fields.description: If damage calculation has to be scaled based on different rules

fields.name: is_spell
fields.description: Is our context 'spell'

fields.name: key
fields.description: entity size enum

fields.name: unit
fields.description: You need to add all units unlocked by that building up unit the specified level, not just the ones unlocked by that level

fields.name: level
fields.description: This is not the building tier.All buildings should start at level 0 and go up by 1for each consecutive level of the building.The building tier is defined by the columnprimary_slot_building_building_level_requirement

fields.name: resource_transaction_on_complete
fields.description: A scoped transaction to be applied upon completing the building

fields.name: override_startpos_settlement_display_building
fields.description: If true, when this building level becomes the region's primary building, it will be treated as a display override, allowing its configured BMDs to be shown on the campaign map. The settlement display system normally only renders models from the building chain established at startpos (with culture-specific BMD variants selected via building_culture_overrides), or from a chain substituted via script using override_building_chain_display; this flag bypasses that restriction without changing the underlying startpos chain.

fields.name: culture
fields.description: Battle culture to determine if the ability is assigned to the unit. Empty field means the unit gets the ability. Specific culture means that the unit gets the ability if it's in this culture when entering battle

fields.name: requires_effect_enabling
fields.description: For the purpose of unlocking the ability via a skill from campaign. If set to false the ability can be enabled/disabled in data for the unit whether it's assigned or not, if set to true the ability will be invisible until it's enabled via data.

fields.name: icon_name
fields.description: This is the icon name in ui/battle ui/ability icons

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type for the ui

fields.name: uniqueness
fields.description: This is 'rarity' of spell, another classification for ui basically

fields.name: is_unit_upgrade
fields.description: If true will appear as toggleable in unit upgrade system in custom battles in frontend. Set to false for effects like crumbling that shouldnt be able to turn off.

fields.name: is_hidden_in_ui
fields.description: If true wont appear anywhere in the UI

fields.name: active_time
fields.description: If this is a projectile then add -1 for active time

fields.name: update_targets_every_frame
fields.description: If active, then each model update it will re-evaluate the targets based on the current position. When off, it will do it once at the start and the targets won't change even if they move in / out of range.

fields.name: always_affect_self
fields.description: The launch unit will always be affected by the ability

fields.name: only_affect_target
fields.description: The ability will only affect the target unit and will not search near units

fields.name: min_range
fields.description: The (targetted) ability can't be used within this range

fields.name: targetting_aoe
fields.description: This is the area of effect to display when targetting

fields.name: passive_aoe
fields.description: This is the area of effect to display when ability has been ordered but not yet cast (like if unit has to move their to cast)

fields.name: active_aoe
fields.description: This is the area of effect to display when ability is currently active (has been cast)

fields.name: activation_effect
fields.description: This is an optional one-shot vfx to display when cast to acknowledge order given

fields.name: miscast_chance
fields.description: The unary chance of a miscast occuring

fields.name: miscast_explosion
fields.description: The boom-boom when miscasting happens

fields.name: special_ability_display
fields.description: When wind_up_stance has an animation added, and windup_time is set to greater than zero, this references a table where you can override effects in the animations metadata.   The effect metadata needs to be set to be set to ability_weapon and ability_aura.

fields.name: voiceover_state
fields.description: the state for the voiceover that's played when this ability is activated (if any)

fields.name: additional_melee_cp
fields.description: Melee Combat Potential that is added to any unit that has this ability/item (from table: main_units). Must be >= 0.0 or the game will crash on startup.

fields.name: additional_missile_cp
fields.description: Missile Combat Potential that is added to any unit that has this ability/item (from table: main_units). Must be >= 0.0 or the game will crash on startup.

fields.name: parent_ability
fields.description: Hack for spell browser in warhammer because designers want to put in specialised versions of abilities for certain characters. An ability with a parent wont show in browser, instead only parent is shown.

fields.name: spawn_proxy_vfx
fields.description: Vfx to show over each proxy decal when targetting spawn spell

fields.name: miscast_global_bonus
fields.description: Setting this to false stops miscast chance modifiers from affecting the ability

fields.name: composite_scene_group_on_wind_up
fields.description: Composite scene group we need to trigger when the ability starts winding up

fields.name: composite_scene_group_on_active
fields.description: Composite scene group we need to trigger when the ability actives

fields.name: use_loop_stance
fields.description: Entities will play a loop locomotion stance

fields.name: spawn_is_transformation
fields.description: If spawning a unit will mean the owner unit will be replaced by the spawned one

fields.name: spawn_is_decoy
fields.description: If spawning a unit the new one will be understood as a decoy of the owner one, the UI will show data for the owning one

fields.name: current_mana_moves_to_reserve
fields.description: If true the current winds of magic mana gets moved to the reserve

fields.name: spawn_shares_health_and_fatigue
fields.description: If spawning a unit will mean the transformed unit health and fatigue will be shared with the owning unit

fields.name: affect_siege_equipment
fields.description: If true affects siege equipment entities

fields.name: shared_recharge_time
fields.description: If provided will set this cooldown timer to all abilities on same group that have the field set

fields.name: intensity_based_activation
fields.description: Activates automatically when intensity is above 0 and deactivates otherwise

fields.name: autoresolver_usage
fields.description: How the ability is used in autoresolver calculations

fields.name: autoresolver_targets
fields.description: Number of targets the ability will hit if it is an aoe ability

fields.name: display_stops_when_display_expires
fields.description: If the ability shoots bombardment/vortex it's display will stop when the assets naturally expire (please make sure the display triggered doesn't loop infinite)

fields.name: autoresolve_cp_multiplier
fields.description: Multiplier for the CP values

fields.name: can_be_copied_to_transformation_unit
fields.description: If this ability can be copied to the connected transformation Unit

fields.name: audio_switch_casting_override
fields.description: If set, ability will use this switch for the modular casting

fields.name: audio_switch_ui_override
fields.description: If set, ability will use this switch for the modular UI

fields.name: ai_usage_template_group
fields.description: If set, ability will trigger on any template.

The Bloody Reaver Deck Guard (Depth Guard)
The Tide of Skjold (Zombie Pirate Deckhand Mob)
The Black Spot (Zombie Pirate Gunnery Mob – Handgunners)
The Lamprey's Revenge (Rotting Promethean Gunnery Mob)
Knights of the Everlasting Light (Empire Knights)
Pit Fighters of Hell’s Deep (Rat Ogres)
The Mordheim Balewolves (The Things in the Woods)
The Wonder of the Age (Land Ship)
Fellwolf Brotherhood (Knights of the White Wolf)
The Frozen Heart of Winter (Elemental Bear)
The Watchmen in the Night (Armoured Kossars)
The Feasters in the Dusk (Crypt Ghouls)
Broken Tusks Mob (Orc Boar Boy Big 'Uns)
Deff Creepers (Forest Goblin Spider Rider Archers)
Da Eight Peak Loonies (Night Goblins – Fanatics)
Knights of the Lionhearted (Knights of the Realm)
The Holy Wardens of La Maisontaal (Battle Pilgrims)
It is no surprise that some Liche Priests excel at manipulating the Wind of Shyish, and are unsurpassed at Death Magic.
Where there is dark there must be light. And so, just as day follows night, there are those in the Mortuary Cult who are skilled at banishment magic, and white wizardry.
The Lore of Nehekhara was created by the Liche Priests of the Mortuary Cult in their quest to unlock the secrets of immortality.
In the shadows of the great pyramids do the Liche Priests practice their dark arts. While some excel in Death Magic, or even Light, others have tamed Phantasmancy.
This Necrotect's one aim is to spend his Unlife colonising a ruined settlement, a power given to him through the Rite of the Great Incantation of Ptra.
The eldest of the fabled First Generation and the original Relic Priest, Kroak labours tirelessly to further the Great Plan.
Some Skink Priests are adept at communicating not just with other reptiles, but with all creatures of the jungle. They are skilled in manipulating the Wind of 'Ghur'.

Skink Astromancers are relatively rare, their spawning marked with a meteor shower over Tlaxtlan. They serve the most powerful of their kind, known as 'the Beholder', who sends them far and wide in service of the Great Plan.
A physician by choice but a Witch Hunter by bloodline, Doctor van Hal both preserves natural life and destroys unnatural evil.
Jorek Grimm is a master inventor unlike any other of his kin – a bold, radical risk-taker.
A solemn and sorrowful Waystalker, Kalara possesses a demeanour that belies her furious lethality.
No mere soldier of fortune, Rodrik’s resilience and swordsmanship make him a valuable asset in any theatre of war.
Quite literally "the Massive", Henri is one of the largest Bretonnian Paladins ever and a loyal Knight of Repanse, who stands by her side through thick and thin.
This Eshin Sorcerer supports his foul brethren through dark arts of stealth learned far from Skavenblight, in exotic Cathay.
Glistening with putrid swamp gunk, Troll Hags sate their voracious appetites with anything and everything they can get their slimy hands on.
Monstrous mutant brawn and a warrior’s instinct make Ghoritch one of the greatest creations to ever emerge from Hell Pit.

For the most revered ancient warlords, death was never the end – they shall live on.

This Plague Priest's one aim is to expend his life spreading deadly plagues to cripple the enemy; a power given to him through the Rite of the Pestilent Scheme.

This Warlock Engineer lives – and dies – to create or destroy, able to expend his life founding an Under-City beneath an enemy settlement, or cripple it in an insane Warpstone-fuelled detonation as empowered by the Rite of the Scheme of DOOOOM!

A Black Orc’s mindless obsession with killing is hard for him to contain, often rubbing off on the boyz around him.
Though Ulrika has taken the Blood Kiss, it does not define her. She remains loyal to humanity, to death and far beyond.
The Koldunja tend the spirits of the land, calling upon them for their placation, summoning or banishment.
The Znarkharja have deep knowledge of all ailments and can tap into life-forces to heal or debilitate.
The Vorozheja communicate with spirits of ill-fortune to twist reality and manipulate the future.
Behold the horrors endured by the hag's foes at the end of her cauldron's smoky tendrils; Mother Ostankya is a dreaded sight to all!

In the shadows of the great pyramids, the Liche Priests practice their dark arts. While some excel in Death Magic, or even Light, others have tamed Phantasmancy.
Those that practice the Lore of Ice are said to have permafrost within their hearts, for that is what it takes to wield this power.
Quick to temper, but compassionate to the folk she protects, the Tempest-wielder is not to be crossed.
Those that practice the Lore of Ice are said to have permafrost within their hearts, for that is what it takes to wield this power.
Quick to temper, but compassionate to the folk she protects, the Tempest-wielder is not to be crossed.
Through life, death, and Undeath, the first and greatest of the Vampire Counts pursues the throne; it is his by right!
To control animals and twist their natural aggression to your own ends shows true mastery of your art.
Proponents of the Lore of Life protect and heal friendly troops and allies, whilst forestalling their foes at every turn.
The holder of secrets and keeper of the way, whose strength is the quester's ultimate test.
Those with knowledge may summon great gusts of wind or fearsome arcs of lightning to harass their enemies.
The bravest of warriors, Paladins charge into battle either mounted or on foot, bringing righteous death in the Lady's name.
Night Goblin Shamans wear the easily recognised hoods of their kind and are known for being particularly crazed due to eating vast quantities of hallucinogenic mushrooms.

Orc Shamans have been known to cause a foe's brains to burst out of his skull, shoot death beams out of their own beady eyes or summon an almighty green foot from the skies to stomp anything unfortunate enough to be underneath.
As wicked as she is learned, no mortal can harm the Unliving Countess of Sylvania, for she reigns eternal!

Nehekhara once stood as a shining beacon of civilisation and human achievement. But this great realm was destroyed through acts of great treachery and powerful sorcery. The living of Nehekhara perished in a single, mournful night, and in their absence, the dead stirred from their graves and claimed the land anew.\\n\\nEven as their ancient civilisation now lies buried beneath the sand, the Tomb Kings have once more awoken from their deep sleep. Rising from their sarcophagi, the mummified rulers of Nehekhara have returned to reclaim that which is rightfully theirs, their legions innumerable, brandishing weapons of polished bronze and priceless gold. Ancient, emotionless and spiteful to all those who have slighted them, woe betide those foolish enough to stand before their silent onslaught.

The origins of the Undead pirates said to ravage the coasts of Lustria are steeped in mystery. Legend has it that a Norscan longship took on a precious cargo during a raid – an ancient coffin containing, unbeknownst to the crew, the Vampire Luthor Harkon. When the vessel floundered off the Volcanic Islands, the drowned crew were raised as zombies through the Vampire's Dark Magic.\\n\\nThe stretch of coastline known as the Vampire Coast has become infamous amongst seafarers, with countless ships wrecked and raised up from the depths to bolster the fleets of the Unliving. Luthor was but the first. In the years since, more Undead pirates ply the seas for bounty and fresh crews.

The Lizardmen are an ancient race of cold-blooded reptilians said to be the first and oldest civilisation. Alien, enigmatic, and entirely without mercy, the Lizardmen were there at the start of all things and will be there when the world draws its last dying breath, never tiring nor relenting until order is finally restored to this uncaring, chaotic world.\\n\\nFrom the primeval jungles of Lustria they come, disciplined cohorts of Saurian warriors with giant scaly beasts in their midst, led by the most powerful Sorcerers the world has ever seen. The ground trembles from their approach. They go to battle for reasons indecipherable to others – an ancient plan known only to themselves.

The Skaven are a cunning and diabolical race of scuttering humanoid rat-creatures that have spread their loathsome corruption to the farthest corners of the world. From deep below the ground, these scavengers have built a vast Under-Empire, whose military power and incomprehensible numbers has the potential to smother the kingdoms of the Old World in a seething tide of violence and anarchy.\\n\\nThey follow the malevolent deity known as the Horned Rat, whose wishes and demands are both supreme and absolute. It is said that the ultimate goal of the Skaven is to conquer the surface world and bring about the Great Ascendancy, whence the Horned Rat's children will swarm across its face and claim all of it as their own.

The Tzardom of Kislev, known as the Realm of the Ice Queen, is the most northerly civilisation within the Old World, a powerful and war-driven country. The inhabitants of Kislev are wolf-tough and self-reliant warriors, valiant and determined in the defence of their Motherland, for they are the bulwark against the horrors of the north.\\n\\nSince its founding, Kislev has been under constant assault by the hordes of Chaos. Countless generations of Kislevites have fought and died in the snowy tundra of those harsh northern oblasts, and it is thanks to these brave Kislevite warriors that mankind has managed to flourish in the south, huddled together in their warm, safe homes, whilst the sons and daughters of Kislev fight on until they draw their dying breaths.

Bretonnia is a feudal society, split between the rich nobles with their gallant Knights and the lowly peasant class toiling in the fields. The Knights of Bretonnia – the flower of its military – have a code of chivalry that forms an unbreakable duty to protect its subjects, and when called to war, are considered by many to be the most powerful heavy cavalry in the Old World. However, a Bretonnian army rarely consists of Knights alone, and so ranks of solid, if unremarkable, foot troops and peasant levies are provided to soak up damage from unchivalrous cannons and other ranged devices.\\n\\nSo it is that in times of need the Knights of Bretonnia ride forth with lances dipped, and a prayer to the Lady on their lips!

Lying at the heart of the Old World, the Empire is the greatest and most powerful of all the kingdoms forged by men. But it is a realm in constant turmoil, both from enemies without and strife from within as rival Elector Counts vie for the throne. Whether fighting between themselves or the many exterior invaders, the greatest nation of man can muster a formidable army of disciplined warriors, magic, steam-powered wonders and menageries of fantastical beasts.\\n\\nNow, the Twin-Tailed Comet blazes across the sky once again and a new Emperor has been crowned – surely an omen that the time has come to unite the Empire, secure its borders and bring prosperity to its beleaguered citizens.

Orcs and Goblins are the scourge of the Old World. Orcs are built for violence; Goblins, by contrast, are smaller but more cunning. Collectively known as Greenskins, they are an aggressive and brutal race with an unquenchable love of fighting. While the Greenskins have made lairs in ransacked Dwarfholds, they can be found across the Old World – the majority residing in the arid Badlands, mainly fighting amongst themselves and only coming together when the call to Waaagh! goes out.\\n\\nOne such occasion is now, and with a strong Warboss to unite the tribes, the time has surely come to unleash da Green Tide and ravage the lands of both humies and stunties alike! For such are the demands of Gork and Mork – and who would go against the word of da Green Godz? Exactly. Waaagh!

Long ago, Queen Neferata stole the secrets of eternal life from Nagash. The elixir she created was flawed, bestowing immortality but at great cost. And so the Vampires were created and they have been a plague upon the living ever since.\\n\\nMillennia later, the darkling figure of Vlad von Carstein arrived in Sylvania – before long, the region's destitute nobility were in his thrall and the von Carstein bloodline was born. Every few centuries, a von Carstein would take the reins of power and strike out against mortals at the head of an Unliving army of zombies, wraiths, Necromancers and other abyssal monstrosities.\\n\\n The Empire has thwarted such legions before, but the dead have never rested easily in Sylvania and now they lurch from their graves, summoned to Unlife by the Midnight Aristocracy as each prepares to challenge mankind once more.
